references.text: Highlights Isaac's confusion and the separation between outward signs (hands) and inner identity (voice).
Highlights the consequence of the mix-up: Esau's despair after his father gave the blessing to the one he thought was him.
Connects Jacob's name/role ('heel-grabber') with the physical act in the deception where hands are central.
Explains the physical mechanism in Gen 27:22: Jacob's smooth skin covered with skins to imitate Esau's hands.
